name: larch
description: Multi-agent workflow automation for Claude Code: design, code review, implementation, and PR automation. SIMPLE vs HARD (`POST_PLAN_WORKFLOW_PATH`) classifies post-plan and `/design` depth only; `/implement` Step 5 code review always runs the unified hard panel (`--panel hard`) with the same base round cap (five rounds, extended when prior rounds were degraded), dynamic archetypes up to the session cap, specialist slots per `review-and-fix.sh`, and a three-judge voting panel each round (Claude + Codex + Cursor; replacements when an external is unhealthy). Plan review uses a four-reviewer diagonal panel (2 Cursor + 2 Codex). `/design` sketch fan-out stays adaptive (0/2/4 agents) via `/design --quick` / `--full` and the router — independent of removed `/implement --quick`.

cursor_model.title: Cursor Model
cursor_model.description: Model for Cursor reviewer (e.g., gpt-5.4-medium). Also accepted via LARCH_CURSOR_MODEL env var. When unset, defaults to composer-2 (with max-mode engaged via scripts/cursor-wrap-prompt.sh). Set to composer-2-fast to restore the previous default.

codex_model.title: Codex Model
codex_model.description: Model for Codex launches — review, implementation, sketches, voting (e.g., o3). Also accepted via LARCH_CODEX_MODEL env var. When unset, defaults to gpt-5.5.

codex_effort.title: Codex Effort
codex_effort.description: Codex reasoning effort for all Codex launches (review, implementation, sketches, voting): minimal, low, medium, or high. Also accepted via LARCH_CODEX_EFFORT env var. When unset, defaults to 'high' at launch sites; probe/health callers do not use effort regardless of this setting.
